name: Autonomous Deep Research Engine
description: Conducts multi-step deep dive research across the web and local knowledge base, synthesizes facts, findings, and references, and documents the results directly into the Obsidian Vault with wikilinks.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Performs comprehensive multi-query research on a topic, compiles synthesized findings, key takeaways, and structured sections, and saves the dossier into Obsidian Vault under Research/<Topic>.md.

topic.description: Subject or question to research thoroughly

focus_areas.description: Specific aspects or sub-questions to investigate

save_to_obsidian.description: Whether to save the research report into Obsidian Research folder (default true)
